ValidationRule.description: DRCi can only enter themselves in the Case Assigned To.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR ( ISCHANGED(Case_Assigned_To__c), ISCHANGED (Upload_to_DRCI_Complete_Date__c)), Case_Assigned_To__c <> $User.Id, ($RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: SKP New Customer Setup' || $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: DP New Customer Setup' || $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: Tech Services New Customer Setup' || $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: DMS' || $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: New Customer Setup'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please list yourself as the DRCi Assigned To in order to update the DRCI Complete Date.
